sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Tap Candy: Sweets Clicker are simple yet engaging. The game is all about tapping to produce candies for customers. As you tap, you will earn money and experience points that can be used to upgrade your equipment and unlock new features. The game also has a timer that ticks down, and if the timer runs out, the customers will get angry and you will lose money. To avoid this, you need to tap fast and efficiently to keep the customers happy.

One of the key features of the game is the ability to upgrade your equipment. As you earn money and experience points, you can upgrade your equipment to increase your candy production and earn more money. This is a crucial aspect of the game, as it allows you to progress through the levels and unlock new features. The upgrades come in different forms, including tap speed boosters, candy production boosters, and equipment upgrades that increase your candy production and earnings.

Another key feature of the game is the ability to unlock new types of candies. As you progress through the game, you will unlock new types of candies that can be produced using special equipment. These new candies can be sold for more money and can also be used to unlock new features and upgrades. This adds a new layer of complexity to the game and makes it feel fresh and exciting.

In summary, the core gameplay mechanics of Tap Candy: Sweets Clicker are simple yet engaging. The game's tap-based gameplay, equipment upgrades, and new candy types make it a game that can be played for hours on end.
